question:
Study the given pie chart and answer the question that follows.

The given chart represents the percentage-wise distribution of the total number of vanilla cakes and chocolate cakes sold on each day of the week. The total number of cakes sold in a week = 10500.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72ed4c9b87e7c8c83ed87245a774ebbadcfc51db7b703c66dd8947d866e2ec5c.png] 

The ratio of vanilla cakes sold to chocolate cakes sold on Friday is 4 ∶ 3. If the price of one vanilla cake is Rs.8 and that of one chocolate cake is Rs. 7, then the total amount earned by selling all vanilla cakes and chocolate cakes on Friday is:

Ratio of vanilla cake and chocolate cake sold on Friday = 4 ∶ 3

4x + 3x = 1050

⇒ 7x = 1050

⇒ x = 150

Number of vanilla cake sold = 4 × 150

⇒ 600

Number of chocolate cake sold = 3 × 150

⇒ 450

Amount earned on cake sold = 600 × 8 + 450 × 7

⇒ 4800 + 3150

⇒ 7950

**∴ The total amount earned by selling all vanilla cakes and chocolate cakes on Friday is Rs.7950**
